      "rationale": "Fixes Windows execution for the bitcoin wrapper so child processes are tracked and awaited instead of exiting immediately. This addresses supported-platform coverage for multiprocess binaries and re-enables previously skipped functional tests on Windows."
    },

      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits in test/ and test_framework/ merely follow from the wrapper fix to unskip tests on Windows.",

      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Test framework changes and unskipping tool_bitcoin.py and interface_gui.py follow directly from fixing the wrapper binary rather than changing test infrastructure itself."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Covers the bitcoin wrapper executable explicitly.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Resolves a core functional defect in the bitcoin CLI wrapper on Windows, where calling _execvp exited immediately with status 0, preventing callers and scripts from capturing output or checking exit codes."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies util::ExecVp in src/util/exec.cpp.",

      "rationale": "Fixes util::ExecVp on Windows to spawn and wait for child processes properly and decodes POSIX errno correctly with std::generic_category."
